subject: Reminder: OPM - Advanced eLearning for the Federal Human Resources - MRAS
description: The U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) seeks market research information from industry to identify innovative commercial eLearning capabilities for modernizing training, development, and skill building for the Federal Human Resources Workforce (HRWF). OPM seeks industry input on creative Learning Experience Architecture, Learning Record Store, and instructional delivery solutions that can support OPM's HR 2.0 Training initiative and modernize professional skill maintenance and development for Federal HR professionals at scale.
